verified_literal_quotes: Blood glucose levels should be checked prior to [ 18 F]FDG administration.
In any case, an examination should be postponed until a proper euglycemic state is reached.
Very few studies directly addressed this issue, and, to date, a measurable effect on scan interpretation has not been proven
acute correction of hyperglycemia with insulin usually does not substantially improve brain image quality
records.authority: EANM Neuro-Imaging Committee NIC primary procedural guidelines; abstract explicitly European practice.
limits: A procedural guideline, not direct proof that this patient has Alzheimer disease or that hyperglycemia alone explains the observed pattern.

Guideline says hyperglycemia can reduce whole-brain uptake and posterior patterns may overlap AD, but measurable effect on interpretation is not proven. Avoid claiming specific AD-like pattern is definitely artifact.
If making a repeat/preparation recommendation, preserve the distinction between postponing a planned exam until euglycemia and proving an already acquired scan is wholly non-diagnostic.
Raw original XML still has >8.9 nmol/L typo. Use mg/dL or explicitly corrected mmol/L; never copy the erroneous unit into a case.

erratum.change: Hyperglycemia threshold unit >8.9 mmol/L replaces >8.9 nmol/L. 160 mg/dL threshold unchanged.
erratum.scope: Erratum corrects the unit only; no clinical recommendation or AD pattern changes.
erratum.correction_not_ordinary_source: No substantive >=300-character abstract; do not pretend it passes normal clinical-source parser. Retain audit/authoring correction separately if not extending correction metadata.

verified_literal_quotes: The 2017 Fleischner Society guidelines recommend pulmonary nodule follow-up based primarily on nodule size, density (solid or subsolid), and patient-specific risk factors.
These recommendations do not apply to lung cancer screening, patients with immunosuppression, or patients with a known primary cancer
records.authority: Peer-reviewed narrative review in Radiologia Medica; not a Fleischner Society guideline or systematic review.
records.title_identity_note: U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE after Incidental. PubMed apostrophes in what's are ASCII U+0027; XML article body title uses curly apostrophes. Use the exact PubMed title, not a hand-normalized title.
limits: Population is incidental pulmonary nodules in adults, excluding screening, known primary cancer and immunosuppression. Correct match to intended incidental solitary solid nodule only if those exclusions are absent.

Exact solitary high-risk6–8mm schedule (CT6–12 then18–24months) occurs in Table2, marked Adapted with permission from reference7. Standard article license excludes third-party material with a contrary credit line; reuse rights for this adapted table are not verified by article-level CC BY4 alone.
Table2 is nested in a paragraph, so the unchanged parser currently copies the entire adapted table into retained body. Parser license acceptance does not resolve the table-specific credit.

Standalone author narrative discusses risk-based surveillance but does not state the same full solitary6–8mm schedule outside Table2. It cannot serve as the second decisive schedule source if that table is excluded.
Independent later review still synthesizes Fleischner2017 and is not a second independent trial/guideline. No Japanese screening guideline should be substituted.
